name: SYD OMEGA 91717 — 16-Block Production Architecture
purpose: Machine-readable architecture contract for scalable, secure, observable and AI-ready production operation.
evidence_policy: A block is not VERIFIED merely because its specification exists. Verification requires executable evidence appropriate to the block.

blocks.purpose: Route, authenticate, authorize, rate-limit and version external API traffic.
Distribute traffic across healthy runtime instances and remove unhealthy targets.
Separate independently deployable business capabilities where independent scaling or ownership is justified.
Decouple producers and consumers with durable asynchronous events.
Provide durable transactional system-of-record storage with explicit schema, constraints and migrations.
Reduce latency and database load without becoming the source of truth.
Partition high-volume datasets when measured scale requires it while preserving query correctness.
Store user media, documents, backups, exports and other large immutable or versioned objects.
Absorb traffic spikes and isolate asynchronous workloads from interactive request paths.
Prevent cascading failures through timeouts, retries, circuit breaking, isolation and graceful degradation.
Deliver cacheable static and media content close to users and reduce origin load.
Maintain service continuity through redundancy, health checks, backup, restoration and defined recovery objectives.
Make system behavior measurable through structured logs, metrics, traces, alerts and audit events.
Protect identities, secrets, data and service boundaries with least privilege, Zero Trust controls and auditable authorization.
Centralize model routing, prompt policy, safety controls, token/cost budgets, model versions and evaluation evidence.
Ground retrieval-augmented AI capabilities in permission-aware, provenance-aware indexed data.

verification_rule: BLOCKED or SPECIFIED is never equivalent to VERIFIED; live credentials and production evidence are required for environment-dependent claims.
